msgs: Left the pack at the Trail Crest junction with a dozen others and started up the last two miles to Whitney.
WHITNEY PORTAL. Down the Whitney Trail's 99 switchbacks and out of the trees to the store: a burger the size of my head. Walked here from Yosemite.
Back at the pack at Trail Crest. The JMT is behind me; now the Whitney Trail out, 99 switchbacks and 8 miles down to the Portal.
HAPPY ISLES. Down past the waterfalls with the day hikers in flip-flops, to the sign. Walked here from Whitney.
MOUNT WHITNEY. 14,505 ft. Signed the register in the stone hut. Walked here from Yosemite: the John Muir Trail is done.
Back at Trail Crest, picked up the pack. Legs shaking, grinning like an idiot.
Down to the JMT at Crabtree Meadow. Camped right by it; the real thing starts tomorrow.
Summit of Mount Whitney, 14,505 ft. The start of the John Muir Trail, two days' walk from the car. Now back down to Crabtree and north: 211 miles to Yosemite.
Afternoon storms again tomorrow. Up early, over the high stuff by noon: that's the rule up here.
Camped on the way in, 10 miles short of the JMT.
Thunderstorms forecast for tomorrow afternoon and a pass above treeline. Alarm set for an alpine start.
Day 1. Happy Isles, the sign that says Mt Whitney 211 miles, and the climb past Vernal and Nevada Falls solo.
Left the pack at the Half Dome junction and took the permit, water and gloves. Two miles and 1,800 feet to the top.
Back down the cables (worse going down) and back to the pack. Now the JMT again.
Forecast says a big storm tomorrow. Big day today to get over the high country before it hits.
The JMT officially ends on the summit, so this is the John Muir Trail minus its last two miles. From here it's the Whitney Trail, the way out.
Day 1. Picked up the permit at the Tuolumne wilderness center and walked into Lyell Canyon solo. 190 miles to Whitney, and the Valley left for another trip.
The cables. Gloves on, hand over hand, rest on the boards, don't look down. Don't look down.
Day 1. Dropped at Horseshoe Meadow at 10,000 ft solo. Over Cottonwood Pass and two days along the PCT to Crabtree. Whitney first, then 211 miles north to Yosemite.
Clouds boiling up over Whitney and thunder to the west. Stood at Trail Crest and looked at the summit trail, and turned away. It will still be there.
Camped on the way in, 11 miles short of the JMT.
Big storm coming tomorrow. Short day, camping low and sheltered instead of up on the pass.
Summit of Mount Whitney, 14,505 ft, on day one. Everything from here is downhill, they say. It isn't. 211 miles to Yosemite.
Top of Half Dome. The Valley floor 4,800 feet straight down off the Visor, Yosemite Falls across the way, and the whole High Sierra I'm about to walk into.
Half Dome. Lay on my stomach and looked over the edge of the face. Clouds Rest, Tenaya Canyon, the Valley. 210 miles to Whitney from here.
Camped at Guitar Lake under the west face of Whitney. Last night on the JMT. Alarm at 2am; nobody's sleeping much.
Day 1. Whitney Portal solo, permit in the pocket, up the Whitney Trail. The summit first, then 211 miles north to Yosemite.
MOUNT WHITNEY. 14,505 ft, and the sun coming up over the Owens Valley. Signed the register in the stone hut. Walked here from Yosemite: the John Muir Trail is done.
